# Edva Programming Language (llms.txt)

> Edva is a zero-keyword, expression-oriented systems programming language featuring
> deterministic memory, algebraic ramifications, and native LLVM code generation.
> This file is a curated language guide and reference index. For the extended language
> specification and core standard library guide, see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).
> Complete module-by-module references are maintained under `doc/reference/stdlib/`.

---

# 1. Core Principles & Hard Rules

- **Zero Bare Keywords**: Control flow words (`if`, `else`, `for`, `while`, `fn`, `return`,
  `break`) are normal identifiers. All control flow is unified into symbolic expressions.
- **No RTTI, Ever**: Types are erased at runtime; function values are `{ fn_ptr, env_ptr }`.
- **Integer Literals & Types**:
  - `Int` is fixed 64-bit (`i64`) on all CPU architectures (no target-dependent `isize`/`usize`).
    Machine pointer width is represented by `Addr`.
  - Unsuffixed integer literals default to `Int` (or the type set by `#pragma integer <type>`).
  - Unsuffixed float literals default to `Float` (or the type set by `#pragma float <type>`).
  - The type system never silently coerces ambiguous expressions or unresolved type variables
    to `Int`. Unresolved types emit `E3103`.
- **Binary Comparisons**: `<`, `>`, `==`, `!=`, `!<` (greater-or-equal), `!>` (less-or-equal).
  `>=` and `<=` do not exist. On floats, `!<` and `!>` are ordered comparisons (OGE/OLE) that
  evaluate to false (`<->`) if either operand is NaN (distinct from `!(x < y)`).
- **Binding Mutability**: `=` binds immutably by default. Rebindable local variables use
  trailing prime (`'`) identifiers (`x' = 1; x' = x' + 1`).
- **Clean Choices**: Single-branch choices `cond | action` evaluate as statements. Never supply
  dummy `| 0` fallbacks. In expression position, choices whose branches all return `RamPN`
  (`< T | >`) or `RamNP` (`< | E >`) synthesize an implicit `| <-->` or `| <++>` fallback.
- **Nominal `#type` Records & Field Checking**: Concrete `#type` record/bitfield declarations are
  nominally distinct (`E3084: Record name mismatch`); `#type B A` creates a transparent alias for
  `A`. Anonymous records `(x = 1, y = 2)` check explicit field names (`E3084`), while positional
  tuples `(1, 2)` unify by field count and element types.
- **Unquoted Imports**: `#use net`, `#use io`, `#use libc`.
- **Unified Strings & Interpolation**: Double-quoted strings `"..."` support single-line and
  multiline (margin stripping when starting with `"\n`). Dynamic interpolation `${expr}` supports
  scalar primitives (`Int`, `UInt`, `Float`, `Rune`, `String`), desugaring to `%to_str(expr)`
  without requiring `#use str`. Triple-quotes `"""` are retired (`E1018`).
- **Line Length**: Lines must not exceed 100 characters.

---

# 2. Operators & Precedence Table

<!-- BEGIN operators.yaml -->
| Tier | LBP | RBP | Operators | Associativity |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cycle | 10 | 20 | `@` `@@` `@>` `@@>` `>--` `-->` `--^` | left |
| sequence | 20 | 30 | `;` | left |
| apply | 30 | 30 | `$` | right |
| feed | 40 | 50 | `$>` `$>>` `$+>` `$->` `.>` | left |
| choice | 50 | 60 | `|` `[pattern]` `!|` `|->` `|+>` `|-->` `|++>` | left |
| assignment | 60 | 50 | `=` `:=` `+=` `::=` | right |
| range | 70 | 80 | `..` | left |
| logical or | 80 | 90 | `||` | left |
| logical and | 90 | 100 | `&&` | left |
| bitwise or | 100 | 105 | `.|.` | left |
| bitwise xor | 105 | 110 | `.^.` | left |
| bitwise and | 110 | 120 | `.&.` | left |
| comparison | 120 | 130 | `<` `>` `==` `!=` `!<` `!>` | left, same-line |
| shift | 130 | 140 | `.<.` `.>.` | none |
| addition | 140 | 150 | `+` `-` | left |
| multiplication | 150 | 160 | `*` `/` `%` | left |
| unary prefix | 160 | 180 | `!` `+` `&` `++` `.!.` `~~` `?` `??` `-x` `#size` | right |
| postfix / apply | 170 | 180 | `call ()` `.` `::` `: cast` `{N}` `@[...]` `!!` `--!` | left |
| primary | 180 | 180 | `primary` | left |

<!-- END operators.yaml -->

Notable precedence rules:
- Infix apply `$` and feed-tier operators (`$>`, `$>>`, `$+>`, `$->`, `.>`) sit below the choice
  tier, and feed-tier operators can start indented multiline continuation lines.
- Postfix error propagation `--!` sits in the postfix tier (tier 18); zero-arg calls use postfix `!`
  (`f!`; empty `f()` is rejected with `E2086`).
- Cycle jumps (`-->`, `--^`), cycle escape (`>--`), and expression-valued `@>` sit in the cycle
  tier (tier 1).
- Bitwise precedence is C-style: `||` < `&&` < `.|.` < `.^.` < `.&.` < comparison < `.<.` `.>.`
  (non-associative, `E2025`) < `+` `-` < `*` `/` `%`.

---

# 3. Algebraic Ramifications & Constructors

Ramifications represent binary outcomes with zero-cost runtime representations:
- `RamNN` (`<>`): Bare `i1` Flag (`<+>` true, `<->` false).
- `RamPN` (`< T | >`): Value presence or absence. Positive constructor `<+ val +>`,
  negative unit `<-->`.
- `RamNP` (`< | E >`): Success or error payload. Positive unit `<++>`, negative constructor
  `<- err ->`.
- `RamPP` (`< T | E >`): Two-payload unboxed register aggregate `{ i1 tag, i64 payload }`.
  Positive constructor `<+ val ->`, negative constructor `<- err +>`.

All payload constructors close with `+>` or `->` (never bare `>`). The four shapes are distinct
types and cannot be implicitly coerced between one another.

---

# 4. Essential Control Flow & Error Handling

- **Choice**: `x [100] "perfect" [90...99] "great" [> 49] "pass" | "fail"` (guards also support negated `x ![...]`, record/tuple OR patterns `[(1, 2), (3, 4)]`, and `#!` type shapes `T [(..)]`).
- **Unwrap-or-Default (`|_|`)**: `val = opt_or_res |_| fallback`.
- **Headless Choice Function**: `classify = [100] "perfect" [> 89] "pass" | "fail"` (a scrutinee-less `[guard]` choice outside an `@` cycle body desugars into a 1-argument function over `_`, callable as `classify(95)` or `95 $> [> 89] "pass" | "fail"`).
- **Pipelines, Composition & Functor Maps**:
  - `x $> f(a)` feeds `x` as first arg (evaluating `x` once when RHS uses `_` or `_(field = val)`);
  - `f .> g` composes functions left-to-right (`(f .> g)(x)` == `g(f(x))`);
  - `r $>> cont` binds positive ram payloads into ram-returning `cont`;
  - `r $+> f` maps `f` over the positive slot (`< T | E >` / `< T | >`), and `r $-> g` maps `g` over
    the negative slot (`< T | E >` / `< | E >`).
- **Record Copy-with-Update & Destructuring**:
  - `rec(field = val, ...)` and pipeline `rec $> _(field = val, ...)` copy a nominal or anonymous
    record and override named fields without repeating the type name;
  - Positional `(a, b)` and named `(x, y)` / `(x = lx, y = ly)` destructuring work in `=`
    bindings, `=>` lambda parameters, and `@` / `@>` cycle binders.
- **Cycle (`@`, `@@`) & Expression Cycle (`@>`, `@@>`)**:
  - Statement cycle: `0..count @ i => (i == 5 | -->)` or condition cycle `(n' !< 8) @ (n' = n' - 8)`
  - Map / Filter-Map: `xs @> (_ * 2)` (`U{}`), `xs @> x => x > 0 | <+ x * 10 +>` (`U{}`), `"abc" @@> r => Rune(Int(r) - 32)` (`Builder` when element is `Rune`)
  - Direct Freeze / Seeded Builder: `+(words @> (_ + ";"))` (`String`), `({}, words) @> (_ + ",")` (`Builder`), `({64}, words) @> b, w => b += (w, "\n")` (`Builder`)
  - Seeded Fold: `(0, xs) @> (+)` (`Acc`), `(0, pairs) @> acc, (a, b) => acc + a * b`
- **Cycle Escape**: `found = 0..10 @ i => (i == 3 | -->) >-- 3` (returns `< Int | >`)
- **Early Return**: `--| value` returns value immediately; bare `--|` returns from void functions.
- **Branch Return Sugars**: `|->` (returns `<->`), `|+>` (returns `<+>`), `|-->` (returns `<-->`),
  `|++>` (returns `<++>`).
- **Error Propagation (`--!`)**:
  ```dva partial reason="error propagation fragment with placeholder step functions"
  compute: Int, Int => < Int | String >
  compute = a, b =>
     v1 = step_a(a)--!
     v2 = step_b(b)--!
     <+ v1 + v2 ->
  ```
